technical_complexity.rationale: Coaching service with wearable data integration and an app; mainly service delivery.

defensibility.rationale: Coach relationships help but offerings were widely copied by larger vendors.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Well funded coaching players existed; Oura launched an employer product in Dec 2022.

market_need_then: Employer spend on wellbeing and burnout was high in 2021 as shown by large rounds for BetterUp and Lyra.

branding.name_origin: Not stated on site; related NudgeLabs name appears in YC bio.

brand_strength.rationale: Site pitches premium coaching to consulting firms; a PEAKPATH trademark was filed Aug 2024 and registered Oct 2025, but no brand press found.

outcome_analysis: PeakPath, a Stockholm team, took part in YC W22 and raised a mid 2022 round from Antler, Brighteye and Devotion. YC lists it inactive while a job board and a 2025 trademark registration suggest continued activity, and no closure news was found, so the status and cause are not public. Totals raised conflict between about 1.8M and 3.04M.
notes: Nordic9 total $1.8M vs CB Insights $3.04M so rounds are missing. Education and prior employers not stated on sources opened. Dagens PS bankruptcy article concerned a different company.
